note: Single source of truth for which justification each item carries and whether the item is part of the analysed 2x2 or a filler. Reassignment is an edit here plus a stimulus regeneration -- never a code change. design_cell is derived from (is_error, quality, role) rather than stored, so the two cannot disagree. item_08 and item_12 carry the weak justification while remaining fillers: that makes the DISPLAYED set 6 strong / 6 weak without touching the analysed 2x2, which stays 4/4 with equal advice accuracy in both halves.

roles.filler: Correct item present so that planted errors are 33% of twelve rather than 50% of eight. Excluded from the quality contrast. Its justification quality is a free parameter -- two fillers carry the weak variant so the displayed set is 6/6 -- but a filler is always CORRECT, which is the property that holds the error rate.
